`web/src/connect.ts`

This is the single module where the ConnectRPC transport and all service clients are created:

- `web/src/connect.ts:184` — the main `createConnectTransport(...)` with the auth interceptor
- `web/src/connect.ts:192-203` — `createClient(...)` exports: `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, `attachmentServiceClient`, `aiServiceClient`, `shortcutServiceClient`, `identityProviderServiceClient`
- `web/src/connect.ts:65-72` — a separate interceptor-free transport plus `refreshAuthClient`, used for token refresh to avoid recursion
